summary: Read-only reproduction on disposable clones (TEST_th_*/TEST_cr_*, browser /pages/theatre|craft-livelihood requests re-routed, non-auth writes aborted, nothing saved). Real theatre & craft-livelihood docs fingerprinted unchanged after both runs. Results: (1) Theatre #past-work: if you select link_label ('Explore Past Productions') and click live-sec-delete, the WHOLE section goes (eyebrow, heading, body and image). Undo brings it back. Clearing the link text with the keyboard (Ctrl+A, Delete) only removes the link; the image stays. (2) Craft Centre: dragging live-move-grip with heading, body_html or eyebrow selected moves ONLY that field (by +83,+57 via a transform). The image and other fields move 0,0, so dragging a text field does NOT reproduce the complaint. The complaint reproduces in 2 ways. (a) Toolbar live-sec-up/down while heading is selected swap the whole section (secIdx 6->5 / 6->7; the image moves with the heading, e.g. imageY 4246->3616, headingY 4425->3746). (b) Clicking the blank gap inside .split-text (22px below its top, between the eyebrow and heading margins; .split-text has 0 padding but 322 sampled blank points) selects _section. Then the grip drag moves image and text together (+50,+40 each), and Shift+Arrow nudges both (+30px). (3) Click mapping is correct on both sections: clicking image, eyebrow, heading, body_html or link_label each selects its own data-edit field. Craft image is a FIGURE with no caption, so no caption could be tested. (4) Theatre separators, measured only: full-width light-grey 1px lines = #past-work .theatre-archive border-top (1440px, rgb(226,223,218), theatre-reference.css:49 '.text-cols, .theatre-archive { border-top: 1px solid var(--t-rule) }'), #theatre-ambition .hb-text.band border-top and border-bottom (1339px, rgb(227,224,220)), #theatre-connect .invite border-top and border-bottom (1440px, rgb(230,230,230)). Small red accents = .theatre-split-rule in the hero (65x2, rgb(163,35,74)), #prayer-meeting h2::after (42x2, rgb(212,20,69)), #theatre-ambition .aside-statement::after (42x2). Nothing was changed.

ui_bugs.issue: Section tools (live-sec-delete/up/down/duplicate/hide) show for every selection and always act on sec.id, even when a single text or link field is selected. Delete on the Theatre 'Explore Past Productions' label removes the whole section, including the image. LiveEditor.jsx 183-185 and 494-502.

Clicking the blank margin gap between fields inside .split-text falls through to _section (pick(): closest('[data-edit]') is null). The move grip and arrow keys then translate the whole section via styles._section, so image and text move together. This is the most likely way the Craft Centre 'text moves the image' happens. LiveEditor.jsx 228-243.
With a text field selected, the up/down arrows reorder the whole section (image included). Users expect them to move the selected element.

issues: Full-width grey rules: past-work border-top, theatre-ambition band top+bottom, theatre-connect invite top+bottom. Red accent rules: hero split-rule, prayer-meeting h2::after, aside-statement::after. Waiting on the user to say which lines to remove; nothing changed.

action_items: When the selection is a field (not _section), the trash button should delete or clear that field only (e.g. set link_label to '' or hide the element), or the section tools should be hidden or labelled 'Section'. Confirm the user wants whole-section delete only when _section is selected.
Remove the Theatre #past-work link (link_label/link_href) through a safe, CAS-aware content edit. Do not overwrite the user's concurrent edits.

Craft Centre / image_text: make blank .split-text space not select the whole section (e.g. give .split-text its own data-edit group, or ignore clicks that fall through to _section inside the text column). Also consider showing a clear 'Whole section' label when _section is selected, so a drag does not move the image unexpectedly.
Decide whether live-sec-up/down should be shown only for _section selections.
Theatre lines: wait for the user's clarification before changing anything.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor.jsx is 705 lines (over the 700-line guideline). The section toolbar is mixed into the selection box, which causes the field-vs-section ambiguity.
Clearing link_label makes TheatreLink return null, so the cleared link can no longer be selected or restored in the editor except with undo.

success_rate.frontend: Reproduction completed: delete bug reproduced; craft move complaint reproduced via _section selection and toolbar arrows, not via text-field drag

seed_data_creation: Temporary clones TEST_th_<hex>/TEST_cr_<hex>, deleted in finally. Real docs unchanged (sha256 checked before and after).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: PYTHONPATH=$(/root/.venv/bin/python -c 'import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])') /opt/plugins-venv/bin/python3 /app/tests/theatre_craft_editor_probe.py. It routes **/api/** and rewrites /pages/theatre and /pages/craft-livelihood (live and public) to the clones. Non-GET writes are aborted EXCEPT /auth/ (login must pass through). Craft blank gap point: about 22px below the top of .split-text at left+20. A drag there moves image and text (+50,+40). Theatre #past-work is section index 2 of 6.
rca of the issue: Delete: the toolbar inside live-selection-box calls remove(sec.id) whatever field is selected. Repro: select #past-work link_label, then live-sec-delete -> the whole section is gone. Move: field drags write styles[field].translate (independent, verified). But blank clicks inside .split-text and the toolbar up/down act at section level (styles._section translate, or the sections array swap), so image and text move together.
